g.title:
'$'''cat <<'''EOF''' > /tmp/dynamic.sh
#!/bin/bash
echo "Sourced dynamic script"
( ( echo "Nested in sourced" & ) )
declare -a local_arr=(a b c)
for val in "${local_arr[@]}", do
 echo "Sourced loop: $val"
done
EOF
' (1,262 us, 0.01%)
'@TRAP (USR1): echo "USR1 trap"\, ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )' (6,422 us, 0.06%)
'trap '\''echo "TERM trap", ( eval "echo eval in trap" )'\'' TERM' (22,358 us, 0.19%)
'trap '\''echo "EXIT trap triggered", ( ( sleep 1 & ) & wait )'\'' EXIT' (22,970 us, 0.20%)
'trap '\''echo "USR1 trap", ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )'\'' USR1' (22,372 us, 0.19%)
